title: Vidur: A Large-Scale Simulation Framework for LLM Inference
authors: Amey Agrawal; Nitin Kedia; Jayashree Mohan; Ashish Panwar; Nipun Kwatra; Bhargav S Gulavani; Ramachandran Ramjee; Alexey Tumanov
venue_full: Conference on Machine Learning and Systems

problem_statement.en: Optimizing LLM inference deployment is prohibitively expensive due to the massive configuration space and the high cost of experimental exploration on actual hardware. Misconfiguration can lead to significant performance degradation and cost inefficiencies.
problem_statement.zh: LLM inference 部署的優化因龐大的配置空間與在真實硬體上進行實驗探索的高昂成本而代價極高；配置不當將導致顯著的效能下降與成本浪費。

key_innovation.en: Vidur, a high-fidelity, extensible simulation framework for LLM inference that uses operator-level profiling and predictive modeling to estimate performance metrics, coupled with Vidur-Search for automated, cost-effective configuration optimization.
key_innovation.zh: Vidur 是一個高保真、可擴展的 LLM inference 模擬框架，透過算子級 profiling 與預測建模來估算效能指標，並結合 Vidur-Search 實現自動化的低成本配置優化。

key_improvements.en: Estimates inference latency with less than 9% error; reduces configuration search cost by several orders of magnitude (e.g., $125 in simulation vs $218K on hardware for LLaMA2-70B).
key_improvements.zh: inference latency 估算誤差低於 9%；配置搜索成本降低數個數量級（例如 LLaMA2-70B 的搜索成本：模擬僅需 $125，而在硬體上需 $218K）。

traffic_pattern: Pipeline Parallelism, Tensor Parallelism, Prefill, Decode
